family_chandelier.name: Family Chandelier
family_chandelier.description: A chandelier that IS a scene tree: grab the button and one mid node swings - and its whole subtree swings rigidly with it, because children live in their parent's transform. add_child made brass. Graph taxonomy rung 2, 2026-08-27.

postman_of_paths.name: Postman Of Paths
postman_of_paths.description: A letter walking a NodePath along glowing ropes between mailboxes - up through '..', down through names, the address printed as it goes. To reach is to traverse. Graph taxonomy rung 3, 2026-08-27.

ouroboros_signals.name: Ouroboros Signals
ouroboros_signals.description: Three telephones in a ring, a call circling forever - connect() permits the cycle the tree refuses, shown beside a small rigid tree with one dashed refused edge. Graph taxonomy rung 4, 2026-08-27.

wallflower_and_star.name: Wallflower And Star
wallflower_and_star.description: A dance floor: one node holding twelve ribbons, a wallflower holding one. Degree as social gravity, counted at their feet. Graph taxonomy rung 6, 2026-08-27.

archipelago_wedding.name: Archipelago Wedding
archipelago_wedding.description: Two islands of lamps, each glowing its component's colour - press the button and a drawbridge edge marries them into one gold. Union-find as a wedding. Graph taxonomy rung 7, 2026-08-27.

two_travelers.name: Two Travelers
two_travelers.description: One tree, two visiting orders taking turns: the tide lights it level by level (BFS), the diver commits to a branch and backtracks (DFS). Every algorithm is an itinerary. Graph taxonomy rung 9, 2026-08-27.

impatient_river.name: Impatient River
impatient_river.description: A spark commutes across stepping stones on the live AStar3D shortest path; sink a stone and it visibly learns a new river. Shortest is a fact about the whole graph. Graph taxonomy rung 10, 2026-08-27.

the_tree_you_are_in.name: The Tree You Are In
the_tree_you_are_in.description: A pedestal projecting a live miniature of its OWN runtime subtree, rebuilt every second from get_children() - the mirror contains the projection as one honest ellipsis node. You have been standing in a graph all along. Graph taxonomy rung 13, 2026-08-27.

switchboard_constellation.name: Switchboard Constellation
switchboard_constellation.description: The graph SUPER OBJECT: an operator's switchboard grown into a constellation - tree plus refused cycles, a five-cord hub, isles married and divorced on the bridge's own clock, a call on the live AStar3D shortest path, the tide, and a desk engraving with one honest ellipsis. 2026-08-27.
